name: PV_Group
description: PV DC generation group connected to an inverter PV input for off-grid power and energy monitoring.

topology.description: Connect to exactly one hybrid inverter or AC inverter across this group.

P.name: Max Power
P.description: Total PV module nameplate DC power installed in this group under standard test conditions. Convert source Wp or kWp to kW.

P.name: String Count
P.description: Number of PV strings installed in this group.

M.name: Start Stop Status
M.description: Reported operating state of the PV group boundary: Stopped or Running. Map only when a confirmed read source exists; do not infer component physical start or stop.

enumData.label: Stopped
enumData.description: An explicit mapped status source reports this PV group as stopped. Use that source to interpret the state independently of instantaneous generation.

enumData.label: Running
enumData.description: An explicit mapped status source reports this PV group as running. Check DC Power separately for its actual generation.

M.name: DC Power
M.description: Total DC power generated by this PV group toward the connected inverter. Use measurements covering this group only.

M.name: PV Energy Total
M.description: Cumulative DC energy generated by this PV group. Map an inverter counter only when its PV measurement boundary matches this entire group.

M.name: PV Daily Energy
M.description: PV DC energy for the current day, calculated by the EMS from the change in M102 relative to its period baseline. Period starts at local midnight. Use the configured reporting time zone and the cumulative source unit (kWh). Requires a configured EMS period rule and a valid period-start baseline. If the baseline is missing or the source counter resets, keep the result unavailable until a valid baseline is established.

M.name: PV Weekly Energy
M.description: PV DC energy for the current week, calculated by the EMS from the change in M102 relative to its period baseline. Period starts at the configured calendar-week boundary. Use the configured reporting time zone and the cumulative source unit (kWh). Requires a configured EMS period rule and a valid period-start baseline. If the baseline is missing or the source counter resets, keep the result unavailable until a valid baseline is established.

M.name: PV Monthly Energy
M.description: PV DC energy for the current month, calculated by the EMS from the change in M102 relative to its period baseline. Period starts on the first day of the calendar month. Use the configured reporting time zone and the cumulative source unit (kWh). Requires a configured EMS period rule and a valid period-start baseline. If the baseline is missing or the source counter resets, keep the result unavailable until a valid baseline is established.

M.name: PV Quarterly Energy
M.description: PV DC energy for the current quarter, calculated by the EMS from the change in M102 relative to its period baseline. Period starts on January 1, April 1, July 1, or October 1. Use the configured reporting time zone and the cumulative source unit (kWh). Requires a configured EMS period rule and a valid period-start baseline. If the baseline is missing or the source counter resets, keep the result unavailable until a valid baseline is established.

M.name: PV Yearly Energy
M.description: PV DC energy for the current calendar year, calculated by the EMS from the change in M102 relative to its period baseline. Period starts on January 1. Use the configured reporting time zone and the cumulative source unit (kWh). Requires annual aggregation support and a valid year-start baseline. If the baseline is missing or the source counter resets, keep the result unavailable until a valid baseline is established.
